title: 第7章 遗产-《我发现了世界BUG》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “所有东西都在这里了。”

    徐峰带着林舒走到书房，指向了徐长顺的书桌、以及书桌后的书架。

    “大部分都是书，他说了全部留给你。”

    “还有桌子上那台电脑，里面也存了一些资料。”

    “如果你带不走，我可以叫个物流给你发过去。”

    “这些东西我们留着也没用了，如果你不要，放在这里也没人会去看。”

    徐峰的语气里透露着一丝遗憾，但又有些释然。

    “其实他留下信我就知道了，他是想把你当徒弟的。”

    “他这辈子没收过徒弟----有人来拜师，但是他没收。”

    “我也不知道为什么他会看上你......可能以后你自己会知道吧。”

    “缘分这东西，本来也是说不清的......”

    一边说着话，徐峰一边走到书桌前。

    他拿起一本摊开的书，上面写满了批注。

    徐峰的手轻轻抚过那些字迹，眼睛眨了两下，最终没有落下泪来。

    “你先看着，我去招待客人----等你等了小半天，一直是我妹妹在撑着，我得去替她了。”

    说罢，没等林舒回答，他便转身匆匆离去。

    林舒回头看向门口，隐约看到，徐峰似乎抬手擦了擦眼睛。

    这是一个标准的华夏男人----他羞于在外人面前表现出自己的情绪，哪怕是对至亲之人的感情也不行。

    可从一点点的细节，林舒能看出来，他对自己的父亲、对徐长顺的感情是很深的。

    这对父子的关系绝对不可能差。

    可能这也是为什么，徐长顺没有把自己的衣钵留给儿子，反而是留给了自己。

    他终究是人，虽然掌握了如此神秘、强大的“仪轨”的力量，但他终究还是有私心的。

    有风险的事情，他不愿意让自己的家人去做。

    ----不过，这又很难解释他为什么偏偏选中了自己。

    他之前可是“拒绝收徒”的！

    自己身上有什么特殊性？

    还是仅仅是因为他知道自己快死了，临时找个继承人？

    也不对吧，如果只是临时找的话，临川市那么多师公、那么多想入梅山派、想学梅山术的人，随便找一个就好了。

    我就不信你一个同行都不认识。

    搞不懂。

    林舒皱着眉头，上前拿起了徐峰刚刚放下的那本书。

    那是一本商务印书馆出版的《汉字古音手册》，出版时间是2010年，从古汉语研究的角度来说，这是一本相当新的书。

    但新并不意味着“不可信”，恰恰相反，从徐长顺做的密密麻麻的批注来看，这本书反而是他最常用的工具书之一。

    林舒随便翻了几页，对照着“蓍龟占卜”的咒语找到了那些字。

    而果然，字的音标跟徐长顺标注的音标是一模一样的。

    很显然，他留给自己的信里的音标，就来自这本书。

    收好！

    林舒把书放在一边，打定主意要第一批带走。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

“Everything is here.”

Xu Feng took Lin Shu to the study room and pointed to Xu Changshun's desk and the bookshelf behind the desk.

"Most of them are books. He said he would leave them all to you."

"There is also the computer on the table, which also has some information stored in it."

"If you can't take it with you, I can ask a logistics company to send it to you."

“It’s useless for us to keep these things. If you don’t want them, no one will look at them here.”

Xu Feng’s tone revealed a hint of regret, but also some relief.

"Actually, I knew it when he left the letter. He wanted to treat you as his apprentice."

"He has never had an apprentice in his life - someone came to be his disciple, but he didn't take it."

"I don't know why he falls in love with you... Maybe you will know it yourself in the future."

"Fate is something that cannot be explained at first..."

While talking, Xu Feng walked to the desk.

He picked up an open book, which was full of comments.

Xu Feng’s hand gently touched the writings, he blinked twice, but in the end he did not shed any tears.

"You watch first, I'll go and entertain the guests - you've been waiting for a long time, and my sister has been supporting you. I have to go and take her place."

After saying that, before Lin Shu could answer, he turned around and left in a hurry.

Lin Shu looked back at the door and vaguely saw Xu Feng raising his hand to wipe his eyes.

This is a standard Chinese man - he is too shy to show his emotions in front of outsiders, even for his closest relatives.

But from a few details, Lin Shu could tell that he had deep feelings for his father and Xu Changshun.

The relationship between father and son cannot be bad.

Perhaps this is why Xu Changshun did not leave his mantle to his son, but left it to himself.

He is a human being after all. Although he has mastered such a mysterious and powerful "ritual" power, he still has selfish motives after all.

He is unwilling to let his family do risky things.

​​--However, it is difficult to explain why he chose himself.

He “refused to accept disciples” before!

What’s special about yourself?

Or is it just because he knew he was going to die and was looking for a temporary heir?

"That's not right. If you are just looking for it temporarily, there are so many masters in Linchuan City and so many people who want to join the Meishan Sect and learn the Meishan Technique. Just find one at random."

I don’t believe you don’t know any of your peers.

I don’t understand.

Lin Shu frowned and stepped forward to pick up the book Xu Feng had just put down.

That is a "Handbook of Ancient Chinese Characters" published by the Commercial Press. It was published in 2010. From the perspective of ancient Chinese research, this is a fairly new book.

But new does not mean "untrustworthy". On the contrary, judging from Xu Changshun's dense annotations, this book is one of his most commonly used reference books.

Lin Shu casually flipped through a few pages and found those words based on the spell of "Tucked Turtle Divination".

And sure enough, the phonetic symbols of the word are exactly the same as those marked by Xu Changshun.

“Obviously, the phonetic symbols in the letter he left to himself came from this book.

                                Keep it!

Lin Shu put the book aside and made up his mind to be the first to take it away.
